race.title: John Rogerson Memorial Handicap Chase
race.verdict: MAJESTIC MOMENT usually goes well at this track, arrives fit and in-form and, back off his last winning mark, is taken to notch up a third course success. Fay Ce Que Voudras arrives in search of a 4-timer and rates the main danger despite not being out since March. Chasing debutants Just Call Me Buzz and What A Dragon are both worthy of interest and any support should be taken very seriously. MAJESTIC MOMENT (IRE) FAY CE QUE VOUDRAS (IRE) JUST CALL ME BUZZ
race.bettingForecast: Fay Ce Que Voudras (9/4), Majestic Moment (5/2), Just Call Me Buzz (5/1), What A Dragon (13/2), Bertie Wooster (10/1), Valirann Gold (12/1), Lord Maher (20/1), Wellwillya (20/1), Elpologreg (25/1), Doonbeg Don (50/1)
